featured_reviews.name: Ryan Rodricks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been here numerous times for swim meets and various events.

The 50M pool is very well maintained, clean and proper demarcation of lanes. Has a full 7 lanes with the 1st and 7th being extra wide.

Has a 5M diving board for diving facilities.

Clean and well kept wash amd changing rooms are provided.

Gets very crowded on weekends and holidays. Especially in the summer.

Coaching facilities are provided and has numerous staff on hand for any swimming and coaching requirements.

The canteen is a bit lacking in food and taste but does provide tea/coffee and light snacks.

The seating arrangements need improvement which is where I deducted 1 star. The seats are hard narrow and cramped and very little space to move or walk around.

Overall one of the best and well maintained pools in the suburbs and maintenance and cleanliness standards are very high.

featured_reviews.review_text: Top-notch facilities! The ozone water treatment makes a massive difference—super clean and great for sensitive skin. Friendly atmosphere and highly recommended!"

featured_reviews.name: Rajiv
featured_reviews.review_text:
Really a very nice pool managed by BMC.
It is a 50 metre olympics size pool which conducts training and hosts various interschool, district and state level events.

Apart from this they maintain a small pool for kids as well.

The Name is OZONE because they maintain Ozonized water in the pool.

The yearly training fee is very much affordable for a normal family as well. They just charge RS. 6800/- as regular fell and almost 1000/- extra for learners. Rs 18/- they charge as daily locker fee and one may opt for a yearly fee of RS 700.

45 mins slot and government staff approach is another prospect where you may feel little disappointed 😞☹️
Parking is also a concern here.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Tondwalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone has two swimming pool. One for the kids and one for proper swimming.
The swimming pool is ozonized and it is well maintained.  There are many life guards for the safety of its members. The pool has maximum depth of 18 feet.

The pools water is really nice and it is one of the cleanest pools in the locality. As a swimmer one can get yearly membership at 6764/- and for learners it is extra 1000/-.

One member has to select one of the batches available and then has to come only during that particular batch only.  There is no particular parking space for two / four wheeler so one has to park on the road at their own risk.

Locker facility is available at 18/- per day basis or a yearly fee if 720/-.

featured_reviews.name: Лилия
featured_reviews.review_text:
After receiving multiple advertisements for swimming classes at Michael Phelps, I enrolled my child in a trial class, eager to see if it would be a good fit for our family. However, after the trial class, I was informed that the school is fully booked and cannot accommodate my child in the regular sessions.

This experience has been frustrating and very misleading. It is disappointing to realize that despite the time and effort spent attending the trial class, there was no possibility of enrolling my child in your program due to the lack of available spots. This crucial information was not communicated to us beforehand, this should be clearly stated prior to booking trial classes.

Advertising trial classes when there are no available spots for regular enrollment is fraudulent and unprofessional. It creates false hopes and wastes valuable time for both parents and children.

I urge you to review this and ensure that clear and transparent communication is provided in the future. Prospective clients should be informed of the availability of spots before enrolling in any trial classes to avoid such disappointments.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We regret the inconvenience you faced. Nevertheless it may be that the spot of your choice wasn't available at the time of your trial. We will try our best to improve the experience for our clients.Many thanks for your feedback.

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the well maintained club around. With plenty of sport options with state of the art facilities. 6 badminton courts with one being matt and also Olympic size swimming pool . Many eating options and also good restaurants to dine at. The banquets halls serves well to host any functions. Lot of parking space open as well as closed. Adequately staffed and good security around.

featured_reviews.name: Shlok Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a life member of GSC for many years and overall it’s been a great place to be. The food quality is consistently good, and the gym is well-equipped with everything needed for a solid workout. The trainers and facilities are generally well maintained.

The club also offers excellent wellness amenities including steam, sauna, and other recreational facilities, which add a lot of value to the membership.

The only downside is that the gym can get quite crowded during peak hours. More importantly, health and hygiene standards in certain areas need to be taken more seriously. While the steam and sauna facilities are good, they sometimes have a lingering smell of oils and can feel a bit stuffy, especially when heavily used. More frequent cleaning, better ventilation, and closer attention to hygiene would significantly improve the overall experience.

That said, GSC continues to offer a strong overall experience, and as a life member, I feel it remains one of the better clubs in the city for fitness, dining, and family recreation.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Goregaon Sports Club is a fantastic place for fitness, fun, and relaxation! 🏸🏊‍♂️ The club offers great indoor and outdoor games, a clean and refreshing swimming pool, and a lovely restaurant serving delicious food. Perfect spot to unwind with family and friends! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Amberdeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the Best sports club in this part of city which actually dedicates good amount of resources for sports and culturalactivities. GSC is loaded with lots of sports and general amenities. They have massive sport ground for cricket and other social events, Olympic size 10 lane swimming pool, separate pools for kids and even totally separate diving pool too. There are couple of basketball courts, multiple lawn tennis, squash and badminton courts. They even have 4 lane pistol shooting range and facilities for gymnastics, calisthenics, crossfit training, boxing and of course a big gym. There is a 500 meter walking track lined with trees and flowers making your walking experience pleasant. You can enjoy variety of food at their different restaurants and food courts. They even have a Library here with good collection of books with accessibility for non-members too. The staff here is very helpful and always there to offer their assistance. The washrooms are never far off as they are located all around the club and always clean and tidy. The club can accommodate good number of car in it's parking.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for quality physiotherapy and aqua therapy treatment. One of the best centers in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: PJ BP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience.

I was passed between multiple physiotherapists who gave completely inconsistent advice, sometimes directly contradicting each other. There was no continuity of care, no coherent plan, and no sense that anyone actually knew or cared what the other had told me.

They push you into buying a 12 session package upfront, creating the impression that you will be properly guided through recovery. That turned out to be completely misleading. On my final session, instead of giving me a clear plan for what to do next, I was told I would have to pay another ₹3000 just to be told how to continue. That is not care. That is a deliberate upsell at the last possible moment.

The quality of the sessions themselves was underwhelming. The physiotherapist I saw most often did not address my main issue, which I had clearly raised in the very first ₹3000 session, until I brought it up again myself. Basic attention to the patient’s stated problem was missing.

They also push expensive aqua sessions regardless of whether they are necessary. Everything feels structured around extracting as much money as possible rather than providing appropriate treatment.

What happened at the end was even worse. I was told I had already been given exercise videos. I had not. This was either carelessness or confusion with another patient, and there was no effort to fix it.

When I asked for my own treatment notes and progress details, I was refused on the basis that they were “confidential.” That makes no sense. I am the patient. Refusing to provide my own records is completely unacceptable.

Instead, I was promised a report. Of course, that was never sent either.

This entire experience felt disorganized, inconsistent, and driven by money rather than patient care. I would strongly recommend going elsewhere.

featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve started physiotherapy after my ACL surgery.  Dr. Jarvis and Dr. Prachi are both excellent professionals. Their advice and guidance have really helped with my recovery. I’m getting stronger every day.
